participants.note: Concept ACK; reviewed functional tests and suggested cleanups and additional test coverage
objected to TxoutType checking condition and suggested code cleanups
reported MSVC compilation failure, anchor filtering defect under subtract fee outputs, and edge cases in key derivation and RBF state persistence
Concept ACK; dropped wallet flag objection in favor of a placeholder txid suggestion, and suggested inlining GetDummyTxOut and using optional for scriptChange

claims.text: the condition would require manual updates whenever TxoutType is extended, risking silent omissions
claims.quote: I think it would be more robust to express this condition using the explicit list of relevant output script types as specified in the BIP
claims.status_note: author implemented explicit script type check

claims.text: whether the fake-use line with a single underscore identifier is needed
claims.quote: nit: is this line needed?
claims.status_note: author removed the fake-use line

claims.text: use std::any_of instead to simplify the check
claims.quote: could slightly simplify by using `std::any_of` instead (returns a bool instead of an iterator)
claims.status_note: author simplified using std::any_of

claims.text: why the coin_control instance was moved up
claims.quote: any reason why the coin_control instance got moved up?
claims.status_note: author reverted the move

claims.text: remove unnecessary createwallet argument from functional tests
claims.quote: Please remove all occurrences of this createwallet argument, it's not required post disallowing loading legacy wallets.
claims.status_note: author removed the argument

claims.text: remove deprecated rbf argument occurrences in transaction and psbt RPCs in tests
claims.quote: Please remove all occurrences of this in transaction/psbt creation/fund/send RPCs that are being used in this test.
claims.status_note: author removed the rbf argument

claims.text: add test case covering bumpfee when outputs argument is passed replacing a silent payment transaction
claims.quote: Please add a test case covering the behaviour when this argument is passed while replacing a silent payment transaction.
claims.status_note: author added test cases for bumpfee with the outputs replaced
claims.status_by_quote: Added new tests for bumpfee with the outputs replaced.

claims.text: add test case covering rbf-cancel of a silent payment transaction by sending funds to self
claims.quote: Please also add a test case covering the scenario where the user is able to rbf-cancel the SP transaction by sending the funds to themselves.
claims.status_note: author added test coverage and reviewer confirmed previous suggestions addressed
claims.status_by_quote: Thanks for addressing the previous suggestions in both the source code and the tests

claims.text: generate xprvs and xpubs dynamically using ExtendedPrivateKey.generate() instead of hardcoding them
claims.quote: After PR #35543 is merged, we don't need to (manually find and) hardcode xprvs and xpubs in the functional tests anymore.
claims.status_note: author updated dynamically generated keys upon rebase

claims.text: remove dead code copied from wallet_taproot.py
claims.quote: It's dead code and should be removed.
claims.status_note: author removed the dead code

claims.text: use a local context manager for setup and cleanup in functional tests
claims.quote: For all these cases where the testing functionality is preceded by setup() and succeeded by cleanup(), a local context manager can be used for readability.
claims.status_note: author adopted the generator context manager pattern
claims.status_by_quote: Changed the code to use the generator context manager pattern.

claims.text: MSVC fails to compile walletmodel.cpp due to referencing a deleted move constructor in a ternary expression
claims.quote: The `Windows native, VS` failure in CI is reproducible on MSVC and directly related to `src/qt/walletmodel.cpp:457`

claims.text: IsInputForSharedSecretDerivation erroneously marks leaf-only Taproot inputs as eligible, leading to failures in CreateSilentPaymentsOutputs, and creates an inconsistency between send and sendall
claims.quote: For descriptors where the wallet only owns a leaf key (`tr(unspendable_key, pk(leaf))`), this returns `true`, but `CreateSilentPaymentsOutputs` subsequently fails
claims.status_note: author updated CheckSilentPaymentsInput to exclude eligible coins with missing private keys
claims.status_by_quote: I have updated the rules in `CheckSilentPaymentsInput` to exclude eligible coins with missing private keys.

claims.text: EraseSpRecipients erases the original transaction recipient metadata on bumpfee, permanently losing recipient records if the original transaction is mined after replacement eviction
claims.quote: If the replacement is evicted from the mempool or dropped while an older block template mines the original transaction, the record of who it paid to is permanently lost.
claims.status_note: author replied that persisted SP recipients info is only useful for fee bumping before confirmation
claims.status_by_quote: The persisted SP recipients information is only useful for bumping the transaction. This can only happen before it is co

claims.text: multiplexing m_is_sp_tx into replaced_by_txid causes replaced transactions to lose their silent payments identity across wallet restarts
claims.quote: Combined with `EraseSpRecipients`, a replaced transaction loses its silent payments identity entirely across restarts.
claims.status_note: author replied that m_is_sp_tx is only needed prior to bumping the transaction
claims.status_by_quote: `m_is_sp_tx` is only useful before the transaction is bumped.

claims.text: restricting anchor candidates to positive_group causes coin selection to fail with INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS at high fee rates when eligible inputs have non-positive effective value
claims.quote: In `AttemptSelectionSP` (`spend.cpp:1058`), anchor candidates are restricted to `positive_group`. At high fee rates, a small eligible coin (such as a 1,000 sat P2WPKH UTXO) can have `effective_value <
claims.status_note: author updated AttemptSelectionSP to use the negative group and sort by GetSelectionValue
claims.status_by_quote: `AttemptSelectionSP` has been updated to use the "negative" group.

claims.text: use a boolean argument and return PaymentDestination instead of templated ParseOutputsWith functions
claims.quote: why not just use a boolean argument and return a `PaymentDestination`? I think this makes it more explicit as to what this function is doing.
claims.status_note: author confirmed change implemented

claims.text: allow duplicate silent payment destinations in ParseOutputs and sendall to support multiple outputs to the same recipient as allowed by BIP 352
claims.quote: Can we remove this and only check for duplicate `CTxDestination` in `ParseOutputs`?
claims.status_note: author confirmed change implemented

claims.text: remove the default constructor and IsValid method on PaymentDestination and make destChange an optional in coin control to ensure correctness by construction
claims.quote: The type can be correct by construction and not rely on the doc comment for the convention. If the default constructor is deleted we can also remove the `IsValid` method as well.
claims.status_note: author confirmed change implemented

claims.text: making silent payments transactions non-replaceable on older software leaves the wallet UI in an opaque and confusing state during fee bumping; older versions should fail loudly with a wallet flag instead
claims.quote: When bumping a transaction the user likely has some urgency, and this would leave the UI in an opaque/hard to understand state.
claims.status_note: reviewer dropped the wallet flag objection after learning it prevents wallet downgrade, recommending a placeholder txid instead
claims.status_by_quote: preventing a wallet open on downgrade is not desirable in basically any circumstance. I can empathize with that approach

claims.text: simplify the comparison operator implementation using std::tie
claims.quote: And if we do go this route, this can be simpler with: return std::tie(a.m_version, a.m_scan_pubkey, a.m_spend_pubkey, a.m_extension_data) < std::tie(b.m_version, b.m_scan_pubkey, b.m_spend_pu
claims.status_note: author simplified comparison using std::tie

claims.text: use a dummy placeholder replacement txid for silent payments transactions so the behavior can be documented and shared as expected behavior
claims.quote: A dummy replacement value could make this easier to share as expected behavior (`00` + silent payments in hex):
claims.status_note: author confirmed change implemented

claims.text: consider introducing an RPC for BIP 352 scanning or adding a Python BIP 352 test scanner in a separate PR
claims.quote: We may want to introduce an RPC for this, but not sure if it should be introduced as part of this PR. A scanner in python that passes the test vectors is relatively straightforward, and we can open th

claims.text: inline GetDummyTxOut and make scriptChange an optional to ensure dummy taproot scripts are not used or signed as real outputs
claims.quote: This function seems like it could introduce surface for bugs. In the case of `scriptChange` for instance, the `scriptChange` variable is used in the actual transaction later. I would prefer if these c
claims.status_note: author rewrote scriptChange logic but declined inlining GetDummyTxOut to prevent duplication
claims.status_by_quote: I rewrote the `scriptChange` logic, but left the other code as is.

claims.text: filtering anchor outputs by GetEffectiveValue() <= 0 prematurely drops valid anchors under m_subtract_fee_outputs at high feerates and causes transaction creation to abort with no eligible inputs found
claims.quote: Checking `GetEffectiveValue() <= 0` prematurely drops valid anchors and aborts with "No silent payment eligible inputs were found" even when the wallet has sufficient funds to cover the send.
claims.status_note: author declined allowing negative effective value coins; Yudis-bit pushed back that non-eligible inputs cover fees while the coin is strictly needed as a key anchor
claims.status_by_quote: Checking `GetEffectiveValue() <= 0` discards this sole anchor and aborts with "No silent payment eligible inputs were found", failing a funded transaction.
